source.compiler: Sumitro Datta, NBA Stats (1947-present), Kaggle, CC0, version 57
source.conversion: computed: score = -2.26204 + 0.0759846 * PER + 0.0694096 * PPG + 0.0538217 * APG + 13.3768 * DWS/G + 0.682648 * minutes share + 0.228396 * All-Star + 0.0448952 * All-NBA; PER, PPG, APG and DWS/G pooled over the season and the two before it, weighted 3:2:1, and shrunk toward the season's replacement level by a prior from their reliability between seasons; minutes share = minutes / (48 * the club's games), pooled the same way; All-NBA 3, 2, 1 for the 1st, 2nd, 3rd team; fitted by least squares on NBA 2K's overall (a z-score within each edition, NBA 2K to NBA 2K26, 2K Archive) against each player's seasons before; each club's 13 players with the most minutes ranked by score and given NBA 2K27's ratings of each club's 13 best, rank for rank; then each club moved toward its results: target = 83.55 + sqrt(0.892) * SRS / 1.900 (the season's mean strength before the move; SRS's reliability 1 - (10.90^2 / 80) / Var(SRS), the game-margin spread fitted to every computed season's records; the engine's margin a lineup point at the season's pace and offensive rating), every player shifted by a whole number and the best few one more, whichever brings the five the engine plays nearest its target
